requirements.summary: Investigate and fix deployment error ensuring proper canister initialization and frontend-backend connection
acceptanceCriteria: The application successfully deploys to the Internet Computer network without errors
All canisters initialize and run properly after deployment

file_operations.description: Review and fix backend actor initialization to ensure proper canister ID resolution and connection handling during deployment. Add error boundaries and fallback logic for cases where backend is not yet available.
Verify Internet Identity provider configuration matches deployment environment. Ensure proper host configuration for mainnet vs local development and add connection retry logic.

Review React app initialization and ensure query client configuration is deployment-ready. Add error handling for initial render failures and verify Internet Identity provider wrapper is correctly configured.
Verify the database initialization gate handles deployment scenarios gracefully. Ensure IndexedDB initialization does not block app startup on first deploy and add proper loading states.

Review IndexedDB initialization logic to ensure it handles fresh deployments without cached data. Add more robust error recovery and extend timeout for slower network conditions during initial deployment.

Verify IndexedDB initialization, upgrade handlers, and migration logic are deployment-safe. Ensure blocked event handlers allow proper database creation on first app load and add better error reporting for initialization failures.
